description: This file defines an interface for distributed cache clearing operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It declares methods for clearing cache lines based on various parameters such as entities, primary keys, and conditions.

classes.name: DistributedCacheClear
classes.description: Interface defining methods for clearing distributed cache entries in OFBiz.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the Delegator instance and user login ID for cache clearing operations.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific GenericValue entity.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Clears cache based on a flexible GenericEntity primary key.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Clears cache for entities matching a specific condition.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific primary key represented by GenericPK.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all caches in the distributed cache system.
